items.heading: מבאר ד' מיני אורות הנקראים: טעמים, נקודות, תגין ואותיות. והם: א. התפשטות הראשונה מפה עד הטבור, היא טעמים. ב. הקומות היוצאות בזמן הסתלקות נקראות נקודות. ג, הרשימות נקראות תגין, ד. אור הנולד מן הכאת הרשימות ואור החוזר היורד זה בזה, הוא אותיות. ובו י"ג ענינים: — כשיסוד עולה מניח רשימה במקומו להאיר למלכות
items.html: And we shall begin to explain them from Yesod, which is the last of those that leave a record. And we say that at the time of its ascent from Yesod to the place of Hod and upward, it leaves 1a record in the place where Yesod had been, for the need of Malchut. And that record never departs from there, even when Malchut returns and ascends to the Emanator. And so do all the rest of the Sefirot, except for Malchut.

items.heading: הרשימה היא שיריים מאור עקודים הראשון שנמשך ממעלה למטה דרך יושר שהוא רחמים
items.html: Now this 2record is from the first light, which was descending by way of straightness; and light that comes in straightness is mercy, 3and light that comes by way of returning upward is reflected light, and it is judgment. Now the record is by way of straightness, and therefore it is mercy.

items.heading: התפשטות הראשונה של עקודים היתה מאירה ממעלה למטה אל המקבלים, והקומות שיצאו עם הסתלקותן האירו ממטה למעלה
items.html: Now it is known that when the Sefirot of Akudim came, their 4faces were downward, for the intention of their coming was to shine downward; therefore their faces were toward the receivers. But upon their returning to ascend upward, then 5they turned their faces upward toward the Emanator, and their posterior downward.

items.heading: בעלית כתר אל המאציל האיר דרך אחוריו אל הנאצלים
items.html: Now upon the ascent of Keter to the Emanator there is no doubt that 6the light of the Emanator is never cut off, not even for a single moment, from the emanated beings who receive. The difference is only this: at that time when Keter ascends upward, then that light which descends from the Emanator descends from him to the Sefira by way of his posterior, for he has turned his face upward and his posterior toward the emanated beings, and it is judgments, as above. And in this way with the rest of the Sefirot, at the time when they were returning and ascending.

items.heading: אורות הפנים הם רחמים, ואחורים הם דינים ונקראים או"ח
items.html: And it is found that even at the time of the ascent of the lights upward, they draw downward a light that descends 7from the Emanator to the lower ones through them and by their mediation, as mentioned. Indeed it is then drawn by way of their posterior, and it is known that the face is mercy and the posterior is judgments. And the light that descends now is called reflected light, since it descends at the time when the upper lights are returning to ascend into their root and into their Emanator, and therefore this light is judgment.

items.heading: חכמה מקבלת מאחור א' של כתר, ובינה מב' אחורים, ומלכות מט' אחורים
items.html: It is found that when 8Keter returned and ascended to the Emanator, before all the Sefirot, as above, that light which descends from the Emanator to the Sefira below Keter is drawn and passes by way of the posterior of Keter. And behold it is judgment, as mentioned. And in this way it is at the time of the ascents of the rest of the Sefirot, save that there is one distinction in this, namely, that Hochma 9receives only from the posterior of Keter alone, while Bina receives from two posteriors, and therefore it is more judgment; and in this way with all of them, until it is found that 10Malchut receives from nine phases of posterior, and therefore she is more judgment than all the rest of the Sefirot that are above her.

items.heading: עוד יש שינוי לפי איכות הספירה, כי תפארת מקבלת מאחורים דגבורה, שהם אחורים קשים
items.html: There is yet another phase, for behold Tifferet receives her light from the Sefira of Gevura, from her posterior, and these are harsh posteriors and very strong Gevurot, as is known; whereas the rest of the Sefirot that are above are not so.

items.heading: כפי השינוים בבחינות הספירות כן יהיה האור הנמשך: דין רפה, בינוני או חזק
items.html: And it is found that according to the change of the phases, so will be the change of that light which is drawn — either a weak judgment, or an intermediate judgment, or a strong judgment. But what they all have in common is that they are all judgments, since they come by way of the posterior, as mentioned. And the pen has not the power to expand and to specify all these particulars that there are in this matter.

items.heading: ג' בחינות אורות: א) התפשטות א' דעקודים מן הפה עד הטבור. ב) הרשימות שנשארו מהתפשטות א ' זו, שהיא רחמים. ג) קומות האו"ח הנמשכות מן המאציל בזמן הסתלקות האורות שהוא דין
items.html: Now it is found that there are here three phases of lights. The first light is the first of them all, called Akudim, which descended and expanded 20from the Peh [mouth] outward and downward until (the chest) the Tabur. The second light is the light of 30the record that the first light left over from that very light which came by way of straightness, and it is mercy. The third light is reflected light, and it is the light drawn from the Emanator to the Sefira, and it is drawn 40at the time when the lights were ascending and returning from below upward; and this light is judgment, as mentioned, since it is drawn by way of the posterior.

items.heading: מן ביטוש של אור הרשימות ואור החוזר זה בזה, נולד אור רביעי הנקרא ניצוצות
items.html: Indeed there is yet a fourth light, born from between the lights mentioned. Namely, when the third light, called reflected light, is drawn 50and descends downward to shine in the Sefira, it then meets the second light, called the record, which remained below. And behold they are 60divided in their nature, for the one is direct light and mercy, and the other is reflected light and judgment, and therefore they strike and clash one against the other. And all the more so, since the light of 70the record longs and desires to ascend to its source, which is the first light, as mentioned; and although it does not actually ascend, for the record remains in existence below forever, nevertheless its longing and its desire are to ascend. 80But the reflected light descends downward, as mentioned, and thus they are found to be opposite in their nature, and then they strike one against the other. For it is known that there is no clash and striking whatsoever except when the lights are divided in their nature. And then there is born from between them, through their striking one against the other, sparks of light from the phase of reflected light, which is judgment, and it is inferior to the light of the record, which is mercy. And these sparks are the fourth light of which we spoke.

items.heading: התפשטות א' דעקודים נקראת טעמים. קומות האו"ח נקראות נקודות. הרשימות נקראות תגין, והניצוצות נקראים אותיות
items.html: And by this you will understand what we said, that in these lights of Akudim there are four phases, which are: tastes, Nekudot, Tagin [crownlets], letters. And this is their matter: the first light of them all is that which is called tastes; and the third light, called reflected light, is what is called Nekudot, as is known, for the Nekudot are the phase of judgment. And the second light, called the record, is what is called Tagin. The fourth light is the sparks that fall, and they are what are called letters.

items.heading: הניצוצות שנקראים אותיות הם הכלים שנקראים גוף
items.html: Now this fourth light, which is the sparks called letters, they themselves are the phase of 90the vessels, as is known, for the letters are called Gufa [body]. And thus it has been explained from where the vessels were made.

items.heading: הניצוצות רק נתערבו עם הכלים, ודומות לרפ"ח ניצוצין שנשארו בכלים השבורים דנקודים
items.html: And it appears to my humble opinion that I heard from the mouth of my teacher, of blessed memory, that already from the beginning 100there were in them phases of vessels, save that these sparks mingled and joined with them, and were in them 200after the manner of the phase of the 288 sparks that remained within the vessels of the world of Nekudim when they broke, etc.
